items.title: Cam Skattebo: Expected to be OK after hamstring tweak
items.text:
Skattebo is expected to "OK" after tweaking his hamstring on a 42-yard run in overtime during Sunday's 27-21 win over the Texans, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

items.title: Saquon Barkley: 'Trending toward playing' Monday
items.text:
Barkley (hamstring), who is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Cowboys, is "trending toward playing," Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports.

items.title: Patrick Mahomes: Two-game TD drought sans Rice
items.text:
Mahomes completed 19 of 33 passes for 165 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 20-3 loss to the Seahawks. He added two rushing attempts for 14 yards.
